02 — Business Management System

ISTA Absence

A web-based absence management platform designed to simplify the management of trainers, groups, trainees, absences and authorizations in an educational environment.

Next.js • React • Laravel • MySQL • REST API • Sanctum • Role-based access

Live demo View code

Project overview

What it is

ISTA Absence is a management application for an educational institute. It covers trainers, groups, trainees, absences and authorizations, with a dashboard for each role.

Use case

Directors, managers and trainers need the same student records, but not the same actions. A shared spreadsheet does not keep those boundaries clear.

My role

I built the Next.js interface and the Laravel API, including authentication and the role checks for directors, managers and trainers.

Technologies

Next.js · React · Laravel · MySQL · REST API · Sanctum · Role-based access

Key features

  • Dashboard
  • Absence management
  • Trainer management
  • Group management
  • Trainee management
  • Authorization management
  • Authentication
  • Role-based permissions

Technology

Next.jsReactLaravelMySQLREST APISanctumRole-based access

Project visuals

Technical highlights

  • The interface is a Next.js application with separate workspaces for each role.
  • Laravel exposes the management workflows as a REST API.
  • MySQL stores the institute records.
  • Sanctum authenticates each session.
  • Roles and permissions gate absences, groups, trainees, authorizations and programs.

Result

The project shows a business application for an educational environment, where the same records are managed differently depending on who is signed in.
